supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: pronounced lateral extension beyond the outer orbital margins

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast; the muzzle area is significantly lighter (higher pixel intensity) than the dark periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate 2D vertical thickness with observable structural droop of the lower lip

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: highly prominent vertical white/depigmented blaze or streak located in the center of the forehead and cranial region
